verdict.rationale: Shopify's payments page says merchants can accept cards, wallets, installments and crypto from day one. Community reports confirm a built-in Shopify Payments module and a 1% surcharge for using third-party gateways instead, so integrated processing exists without wiring an external gateway. Payouts appear only in a community report of recurring payout freezes, and no evidence covers card rates or fraud tooling. Missing for 10: published card rate schedule, fraud/chargeback tooling, first-party payout documentation, evidence that payouts are reliable.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can take payments with the platform's integrated processing — published card rates, payouts, and fraud tooling — without wiring a third-party gateway

citations.quote: Accept cards, wallets, installments, and crypto—from day one.
they introduced their Shopify Payment Module which runs on Stripe
